message: LocateAnything-3B zero-shot, transformers trust_remote_code, vision=flash_attention_2 + text=sdpa (Qwen2's forward() doesn't implement flash_attention_2, sdpa is the only non-Hopper/Blackwell option), do_sample=True/temp=0.7/top_p=0.9/rep_penalty=1.1/seed=0 (greedy decoding caused a reproducible degenerate-repeat failure -- confirmed via raw-output inspection: model emits 1-2 real boxes then repeats one degenerate near-full-image box hundreds of times until max_new_tokens), 5x ground_multi() calls per image (1 per LOCO category, same CATEGORY_PROMPTS as SAM3/GDINO/OWLv2) to avoid undocumented multi-category answer disambiguation, dedup identical boxes as a belt-and-suspenders guard. CAVEAT: model exposes no per-box confidence -- every box scored 1.0 as placeholder, so AP_50/AP_50-95 here are NOT a true ranked precision-recall curve, not directly comparable to sam3/gdino/owlv2's real ranked-score AP in this same table. 150-image seed=42 random sample freshly drawn from loco_val_paths.txt this session (not the same exact images as the old sam3/gdino/owlv2 150-sample, which no longer exists on disk). Run for 3-way comparison vs SAM3 (sam3_v9) and Grounding DINO (gdino_v5) on the same sample.
